name: Deck Builder
description: Build a presentation from an article or outline: generate the deck, render it as HTML slides, apply one consistent theme, and clean up the source Markdown first so every slide carries the same structure.
description_zh: 拿一篇文章或提纲做出整套幻灯片：先生成内容，再渲染成浏览器里能翻页的 HTML，套上统一的主题，原稿的 Markdown 也顺手规整一遍。
